entry.title: ESMA publishes final report on MiCA technical standards
entry.summary: The European Securities and Markets Authority has finalised the technical standards under the Markets in Crypto-Assets Regulation, covering authorisation, conduct of business, and market abuse provisions.

entry.title: Consultation on MiFID II transparency review
entry.summary: ESMA launches consultation on proposed amendments to the MiFID II transparency regime for non-equity instruments. Responses due 30 April 2026.
